body:
## Intent
Freeze the cross-repo contract for **ADR-017 (consequence gating)** *before* the
engine implements it, so the operator config shape, the additive envelope
evidence, and the error taxonomy are stable. Contract-first per D-011/D-012.

Source of truth (read first):
- `rigorix-oss/engine/.pi/architecture/decisions/ADR-017-consequence-gating.md`
- `rigorix-oss/engine/.pi/architecture/modules/consequence-gating.md`

## In scope
- `schemas/policy.json` — the `[[preconditions]]` shape and `[gating]`:
  - `id`, `match` (reuse `StepPredicate`), `require_params[]`, `command[]` (argv),
    `timeout_ms` (default 5000), `failure` (`deny`), `capture_output` (default false)
  - `gating.release_dependents_on_failure` (default true)
  - extend `[[requirements]]` with `require_companion_step = { match = <StepPredicate> }`
- `schemas/envelope.json` — additive `precondition_findings[]`:
  - `precondition_id`, `step`, `outcome` (`passed|failed|error|unarmed`),
    `exit_code`, `inputs_hash`, `checked_at`, `summary`
  - serde default / skip-if-empty so legacy envelopes verify unchanged
- `schemas/api/errors.json` — precondition denial taxonomy (`retriable: false`)
- `schemas/fixtures/envelope/envelope-precondition-signed.json` — a real signed
  fixture carrying `precondition_findings[]`

## Out of scope
- Any engine implementation (tracked in rigorix-oss)
- Enterprise ingestion (separate issue)
- New `rigorix.*` catalog methods — the namespace is frozen (ADR-0001 D3);
  this is config + evidence only

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `policy.json` describes preconditions + gating with serde-exact field names
- [ ] `envelope.json` adds `precondition_findings[]` additively; absent ⇒ chain/HMAC bytes unchanged
- [ ] `errors.json` declares the denial type with `retriable: false`
- [ ] A signed fixture verifies byte-exact in **Rust / Python / TypeScript / Java / Go**
- [ ] OSS + enterprise drift CI stays green; `verify_catalog_subset` unaffected
- [ ] `catalog.json` method count unchanged (23)

## Notes
Field order in `canonical_envelope_bytes` is defined by the schema — match the
engine struct position exactly or every cross-language verifier breaks.
Do **not** record parameter values in evidence (only `inputs_hash`).
title: feat(contract): freeze precondition config + envelope precondition_findings (ADR-017)
